description: This Java source file defines the ChromeNativeTestActivity class, which extends ChromiumActivity to run native tests within the Chromium project on Android. It manages loading native libraries, running tests on a separate thread or main thread, and handles test failure signaling.

classes.name: ChromeNativeTestActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class that loads native libraries and runs native tests, either on a separate thread or on the main thread with a delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads the native library, and schedules or starts test execution.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Calls the native method to run tests, passing directory and context information.

methods.name: nativeTestFailed
methods.description: Logs a failure message when native library loading or testing fails.

methods.name: loadLibrary
methods.description: Loads the specified native library, throws exception if it fails.
